Title: Match length
Body: To be confirmed by the organising committee.

Title: Who can play
Body: Old boys and old girls of the school, playing for the team of their year group.

Title: Points & ranking
Body: Win 3, draw 1, loss 0. Group ties are broken by goal difference, goals scored, then head-to-head.

Title: Knockouts
Body: Top 2 in each group + the 2 best third-placed teams reach the quarterfinals. A level knockout match goes straight to penalties.

Title: Cards
Body: A red card means the player sits out the rest of that match.
